metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 instance activity
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false
) {
let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
[
  "AssociateApplicationStatusCheck", "Set", "Application Status Check Association",
  "AssociateIamInstanceProfile", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "AssociateInstanceEventWindow", "Set", "Instance Event Window",
  "CreateApplicationStatusCheck", "Create", "Application Status Check",
  "CreateInstanceEventWindow", "Create", "Instance Event Window",
  "DeleteApplicationStatusCheck", "Delete", "Application Status Check",
  "DeleteInstanceEventWindow", "Delete", "Instance Event Window",
  "DescribeApplicationStatus", "Read", "EC2 Instance Application Status",
  "DescribeApplicationStatusCheckAssociations", "Read", "Application Status Check Association",
  "DescribeApplicationStatusChecks", "Read", "Application Status Check",
  "DescribeIamInstanceProfileAssociations", "Read", "IAM Instance Profile Association",
  "DescribeInstanceAttribute", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceCreditSpecifications", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", "Read", "Instance Event Notification Attribute",
  "DescribeInstanceEventWindows", "Read", "Instance Event Window",
  "DescribeInstanceImageMetadata", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceSqlHaHistoryStates", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceSqlHaStates", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceStatus", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstances", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DisableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", "Disable", "Application Status Check Suppression",
  "DisableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", "Disable", "EC2 Instance",
  "DisassociateApplicationStatusCheck", "Delete", "Application Status Check Association",
  "DisassociateIamInstanceProfile", "Delete", "IAM Instance Profile Association",
  "DisassociateInstanceEventWindow", "Set", "Instance Event Window",
  "EnableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", "Enable", "Application Status Check Suppression",
  "EnableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", "Enable", "EC2 Instance",
  "GetDefaultCreditSpecification", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "GetInstanceMetadataDefaults", "Read", "Instance Metadata Defaults",
  "GetInstanceUefiData", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyApplicationStatusCheck", "Set", "Application Status Check",
  "ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceAttribute", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceCpuOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceCreditSpecification", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceEventStartTime", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceEventWindow", "Set", "Instance Event Window",
  "ModifyInstanceMaintenanceOptions", "Set", "IMDS",
  "ModifyInstanceMetadataDefaults", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstanceNetworkPerformanceOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyInstancePlacement", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyPrivateDnsNameOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
  "ModifyPublicIpDnsNameOptions", "Set", "Network Interface",
  "MonitorInstances", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
  "RebootInstances", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
  "RegisterInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", "Create", "Instance Event Notification Attribute",
  "ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation", "Set", "IAM Instance Profile Association",
  "ReportInstanceStatus", "Other", "EC2 Instance",
  "ResetInstanceAttribute", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
  "RunInstances", "Start", "EC2 Instance",
  "SendDiagnosticInterrupt", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
  "StartInstances", "Start", "EC2 Instance",
  "StopInstances", "Stop", "EC2 Instance",
  "TerminateInstances", "Stop", "EC2 Instance",
  "UnmonitorInstances", "Execute", "EC2 Instance"
]
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any);
AWSCloudTrail
| where not(disabled)
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventName has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserIdentityUserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    or (ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0")
        and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
| where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
| extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
| lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
| extend Req = todynamic(RequestParameters), Resp = todynamic(ResponseElements)
| extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
    EventName == "AssociateApplicationStatusCheck", Resp.successfulResultSet,
    EventName == "AssociateIamInstanceProfile", Resp.iamInstanceProfileAssociation,
    EventName == "AssociateInstanceEventWindow", Resp.instanceEventWindow,
    EventName == "CreateApplicationStatusCheck", Resp.applicationStatusCheck,
    EventName == "CreateInstanceEventWindow", Resp.instanceEventWindow,
    EventName == "DisableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", Resp.successfulResultSet,
    EventName == "EnableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", Resp.successfulResultSet,
    EventName == "ModifyApplicationStatusCheck", Resp.applicationStatusCheck,
    EventName == "ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification", Resp.instanceFamilyCreditSpecification,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceAttribute", Req.Attribute,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes",
      Req.CapacityReservationSpecification,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceCpuOptions", Resp,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceEventStartTime", Resp.event,
    EventName == "ModifyPublicIpDnsNameOptions", Req.HostnameType,
    EventName == "MonitorInstances", Resp.instancesSet,
    EventName == "RegisterInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", Resp.instanceTagAttribute,
    EventName == "ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation", Resp.iamInstanceProfileAssociation,
    EventName == "RunInstances", Resp.groupSet,
    EventName == "StartInstances", Resp.instancesSet,
    EventName == "StopInstances", Resp.instancesSet,
    EventName == "UnmonitorInstances", Resp.instancesSet,
    ""
  ), "")
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
| extend ObjectId = case(
    EventName == "AssociateApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(Req.applicationStatusCheckId,
      Req.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
    EventName == "AssociateIamInstanceProfile", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "AssociateInstanceEventWindow", Req.InstanceEventWindowId,
    EventName == "CreateApplicationStatusCheck",
      Resp.applicationStatusCheck.applicationStatusCheckId,
    EventName == "CreateInstanceEventWindow", Resp.instanceEventWindow.instanceEventWindowId,
    EventName == "DeleteApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(Req.applicationStatusCheckId,
      Req.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
    EventName == "DeleteInstanceEventWindow", Req.InstanceEventWindowId,
    EventName == "DescribeIamInstanceProfileAssociations", Req.AssociationId,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceAttribute", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceCreditSpecifications", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceEventWindows", Req.InstanceEventWindowId.N,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceImageMetadata", Req.InstanceId.N,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceSqlHaHistoryStates", Req.InstanceId.N,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceSqlHaStates", Req.InstanceId.N,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceStatus", Req.InstanceId.N,
    EventName == "DescribeInstances", Req.InstanceId.N,
    EventName == "DisableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "DisassociateApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(Req.applicationStatusCheckId,
      Req.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
    EventName == "DisassociateIamInstanceProfile", Req.AssociationId,
    EventName == "DisassociateInstanceEventWindow", Req.InstanceEventWindowId,
    EventName == "EnableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "GetInstanceUefiData", Resp.instanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(Req.applicationStatusCheckId,
      Req.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
    EventName == "ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification",
      Resp.instanceFamilyCreditSpecification.instanceFamilyCreditSpecificationId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceAttribute", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceCpuOptions", Resp.instanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceCreditSpecification", Req.InstanceCreditSpecification,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceEventStartTime", Req.InstanceEventId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceEventWindow", Req.InstanceEventWindowId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceMaintenanceOptions", Resp.instanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions", Resp.instanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstanceNetworkPerformanceOptions", Resp.instanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyInstancePlacement", Resp.instanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyPrivateDnsNameOptions", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "ModifyPublicIpDnsNameOptions", Req.NetworkInterfaceId,
    EventName == "MonitorInstances", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "RebootInstances", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation",
      Resp.iamInstanceProfileAssociation.associationId,
    EventName == "ReportInstanceStatus", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "ResetInstanceAttribute", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "RunInstances", Resp.requesterId,
    EventName == "SendDiagnosticInterrupt", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "StartInstances", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "StopInstances", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "TerminateInstances", Req.InstanceId,
    EventName == "UnmonitorInstances", Req.InstanceId,
    ""
  )
| extend
    Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventVendor = "AWS",
    EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
    Dvc = "CloudTrail",
    EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
    ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
    TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
    TargetAppType = "Service"
| project-rename
    EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
    EventOriginalType = EventName,
    EventUid = AwsEventId,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
    EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
    ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
    ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
    ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
| extend
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
    TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
    "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
    "APIVersion", APIVersion,
    "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
    "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
    "RequestParameters", Req,
    "ResponseElements", Resp
  ), dynamic({}))
| extend
    Operation = EventOriginalType,
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName,
    Value = NewValue
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
    EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
    EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
    ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
    SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
    Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
    AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(
  starttime,
  endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in,
  eventresult,
  object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any,
  disabled,
  pack
)
